description: Agent execution environments (AGENT-ENV, D-341): the parameters of the declarations in config/agent-env/ and of their validator, scripts/lib/agent_env.py.

agent-env.denied_names.description: Shell-style patterns (fnmatch, case-sensitive) of the variable and secret names the engine never sends to a cloud agent (AGENTS.md Cloud setup): database URLs, R2 keys, AUTH_*, OU_GOOGLE_*, Mux, Figma and blob tokens. The validator, the delivery and the client refuse a name that matches one, and a name that matches a retired vendor term (structure.retired_vendor_terms, D-318), which covers the site's former hosting and database tokens without naming them here.
